headline: Ukraine Says New Offensive Is Underway in Northern Donetsk
seoTitle: Ukraine Says New Offensive Is Underway in Northern Donetsk | FMB Worldwide
seoDescription: A senior Ukrainian commander says forces cleared about 75 square kilometers of Russian infiltration and recaptured another 10 square kilometers in northern Donetsk; Reuters could not independently verify the claims.
deck: A senior Ukrainian commander announced an offensive near the Sloviansk–Kramatorsk defensive belt, but the territorial claims remain difficult to independently verify in the drone-dominated battlefield.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Ukraine says it has launched a new offensive operation in northern Donetsk near the strategically important cities of Sloviansk and Kramatorsk.
Brigadier-General Andrii Biletskyi said Ukrainian forces had cleared about 75 square kilometers of Russian infiltration and recaptured another 10 square kilometers, including several settlements.
Reuters said it could not independently verify the territorial claims.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Russia continues operations aimed at taking the remainder of Donetsk region, while both sides increasingly operate across contested zones shaped by drones, small-unit infiltration and rapidly changing control.
That battlefield environment makes conventional front lines harder to establish and means territorial announcements from either side require careful attribution.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The Sloviansk–Kramatorsk area is an important Ukrainian defensive and population center in Donetsk. Any sustained shift in the surrounding front could affect Russia’s wider campaign in the region.
For readers, the distinction between a military claim and independently confirmed territorial control is essential in a fast-moving war.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for independent geolocation or battlefield assessments, Russian responses to the Ukrainian claims, and whether Ukraine can hold any territory it says it has regained.

verificationNotes: The 75-square-kilometer clearing and additional 10-square-kilometer recapture figures are attributed to Brigadier-General Andrii Biletskyi and the Third Army Corps in both Reuters and Ukrainska Pravda reporting.
Reuters said it could not independently verify the territorial claims, and the article preserves that qualification.
